item.title: VW y sindicato discutirán la próxima semana las preocupaciones sobre la reestructuración: fuente
item.description: Volkswagen y los representantes sindicales se reunirán la próxima semana para debatir la reestructuración radical del fabricante de automóviles alemán, según informó el miércoles una fuente a Reuters, después de que el sindicato IG Metall convocara a la dirección ante la preocupación por los recortes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen y los representantes sindicales se reunirán la próxima semana para debatir la reestructuración radical del fabricante de automóviles alemán, según informó el miércoles una fuente a Reuters, después de que el sindicato IG Metall convocara a la dirección ante la preocupación por los recortes. Los representantes de la empresa, de IG Metall y del comité de empresa se reunirán en Hannover el 30 de septiembre, según indicó la fuente involucrada en las negociaciones. El periódico financiero Handelsblatt fue el primero en dar a conocer la fecha. Más temprano en el mes, IG Metall anunció que invocaría una cláusula especial de su histórico convenio colectivo de 2024 con Volkswagen , exigiendo que la empresa cumpliera los compromisos en materia de empleo e inversión adquiridos en dicho acuerdo. Esta medida supuso una escalada en la lucha por el futuro de Volkswagen. El conflictivo consejo de supervisión del grupo aprobó este mes un plan para duplicar los despidos hasta alcanzar unas 100.000 personas, pero aún quedan muchos detalles por acordar. Las plantas de producción alemanas se encuentran bajo una presión especial, ya que cuatro de ellas se enfrentan a un posible cierre a partir de principios de la próxima década.

item.title: Bulgaria lifts fuel export ban to ease Lukoil's refinery operations
item.description: Bulgaria on Wednesday approved lifting a ban on fuel exports to other EU countries that has been in place since last year to protect domestic supplies after US sanctions targeted Russia's Lukoil, operator of the country's biggest oil refinery.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bulgaria on Wednesday approved lifting a ban on fuel exports to other EU countries that [USN:L6N3WC0SZ TEXT:"has been in place"] since last year to protect domestic supplies after US sanctions targeted Russia's Lukoil, operator of the country's biggest oil refinery. The measure was approved by parliament by 121 votes to 42, with 23 lawmakers abstaining. The government has said the ban, mainly on diesel and aviation fuel, hit the activities of Lukoil's (LKOH.MM) refinery and posed significant administrative and organisational difficulties for fuel businesses, causing financial losses for some operators which failed to meet contractual obligations to international partners. It also said the ban went against the free movement of goods principle of the EU single market. Lukoil runs Bulgaria's 190,000-barrel-per-day Burgas oil refinery, operates more than 200 petrol stations and has a fuel transport and depot network.

item.title: Víctimas de presuntos abusos de sacerdote esloveno piden a papa León XIV acelerar juicio eclesiástico
item.description: Cinco víctimas de presuntos abusos por parte de un destacado sacerdote vinculado al Vaticano instaron el miércoles al papa León XIV a que presione para que concluya el juicio eclesiástico contra el clérigo, que ya dura casi un año, alegando que un proceso prolongado y secreto les está privando de justicia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cinco víctimas de presuntos abusos por parte de un destacado sacerdote vinculado al Vaticano instaron el miércoles al papa León XIV a que presione para que concluya el juicio eclesiástico contra el clérigo, que ya dura casi un año, alegando que un proceso prolongado y secreto les está privando de justicia. En una carta abierta previa a la visita de cuatro días de León XIV a Francia, donde el Santo Padre espera restaurar la reputación de la Iglesia tras los escándalos de abusos ocurridos allí, las víctimas del reverendo Marko Rupnik dijeron que el trato que han recibido pone en entredicho el compromiso de la Iglesia de ayudar a las víctimas. "Este es el mensaje que se transmite… que es inútil denunciar los abusos a las autoridades eclesiásticas, porque de todos modos no pasa nada y nadie rendirá cuentas", se lee en la carta. Las víctimas dijeron que no habían recibido ninguna información sobre el juicio eclesiástico y que no habían podido prestar testimonio. Instaron al Sumo Pontífice a presionar para que se celebre un juicio justo "de modo que la sentencia y su resultado, sea cual sea, queden libres de toda sombra de duda". La oficina de prensa del Vaticano no hizo comentarios de inmediato. Rupnik, un sacerdote esloveno, es un artista religioso cuyos mosaicos adornan unas 200 iglesias y capillas de todo el mundo, incluida una basílica en Lourdes, Francia, que el Papa visitará el sábado. El obispo de Lourdes ha ordenado que se cubran los mosaicos con motivo de la visita del Papa. Más de 20 mujeres, en su mayoría antiguas monjas, han acusado a Rupnik de abusos sexuales y psicológicos. El sacerdote fue expulsado de la orden de los jesuitas en 2023, tras considerarse que las acusaciones contra él eran "muy altamente" creíbles. El responsable de la poderosa oficina doctrinal del Vaticano anunció por primera vez un juicio eclesiástico contra Rupnik en octubre de 2025. Estos juicios se celebran a puerta cerrada y desde entonces ha habido pocas novedades. En julio, el Vaticano desmintió las informaciones que apuntaban a que se hubiera tomado una decisión sobre el caso.

item.title: India's Ultraviolette taps Intel CEO as adviser, raises $85 million
item.description: India's Ultraviolette brought on Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan as an adviser, the electric motorcycle manufacturer said on Wednesday, as it plans to expand internationally.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Ultraviolette brought on Intel (INTC.O) CEO Lip-Bu Tan as an adviser, the electric motorcycle manufacturer said on Wednesday, as it plans to expand internationally. Tan also participated in an $85 million funding round, along with deep-tech venture capital firms, with the Indian firm aiming to increase production and expand its product line. Here are some more details: TVS Motor-backed (TVSM.NS) Ultraviolette, which has a presence in Europe and India, is targeting a US entry in 2027, along with expansion across key markets in Latin America and Southeast Asia. Yali Capital, where Tan serves as an adviser, and TDK Ventures participated in the funding round, along with other investors. Ultraviolette will use the newly raised funds to scale production for its current products, launch upcoming models Tesseract and Shockwave, and develop its next generation of EV platforms. Reuters [USN:L6N4500JH TEXT:"earlier reported"] that the EV startup is looking to invest 7.79 billion rupees ($81.37 million) in a new plant to expand its manufacturing capacity and support its entry into the mass-market segment. Ultraviolette registrations have nearly tripled year-to-date compared to the previous year, according to data from the national vehicle registry, as Indians increasingly adopt electric vehicles due to their lower operating costs, fuel-price volatility and regulatory support. ($1 = 95.7400 Indian rupees)

item.title: エチオピア北部で戦闘再燃、反政府勢力が空港掌握
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - アフリカのエチオピア北部ティグレ州の指導部は２３日、連邦政府との新たな戦争に入ったと表明した。ティグレ州と隣接するアファール州、アムハラ州で戦闘が発生し、４年前に結ばれた和平合意は崩壊した。

アビー首相の顧問は、反政府勢力のティグレ人民解放戦線（ＴＰＬＦ）がティグレ州内で連邦政府の管理下にあった空港を掌握し、隣接するアファール州とアムハラ州の政府軍拠点に対して「全面攻勢」を開始したとＸに投稿。エチオピア航空はティグレ州向けの運航を停止した。

エチオピアでは、２０２０─２２年にＴＰＬＦと連邦政府軍の間で内戦が起き、数十万人が死亡した。２２年１１月にプレトリア合意が締結されたが、数カ月前から対立が強まり、ＴＰＬＦは２１日、アビー政権打倒を目指し、エチオピア各地の武装組織６団体と同盟を結成したと発表していた。

ＴＰＬＦ主導のティグレ州政府は声明で「アビー・アハメドの独裁的かつジェノサイド的な政権が、ティグレの人々に対してさまざまな手段による侵攻を激化させたことを受け、ティグレ州政府はティグレ軍に反撃を指示し、防衛戦争に入ったと発表した」と述べた。

item.title: Sindicato de supervisores de mina chilena Escondida dice buscará rechazar oferta de contrato; abrir vía a huelga
item.description: El sindicato de supervisores de la mina chilena de cobre Escondida, controlada por BHP, buscará que sus socios rechacen una oferta presentada por la compañía, lo que allanaría el camino a una huelga en el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, informó el gremio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El sindicato de supervisores de la mina chilena de cobre Escondida, controlada por BHP, buscará que sus socios rechacen una oferta presentada por la compañía, lo que allanaría el camino a una huelga en el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, informó el gremio. La empresa presentó al final de la jornada del martes la última propuesta del proceso formal de diálogo, que ahora será votada del 28 al 30 de septiembre por los integrantes del sindicato. "Esta última oferta que entrega la empresa carece de los temas esenciales", dijo el presidente del gremio, Alexis Barrera, en un video enviado a los socios. "Como directorio de forma unánime rechazamos esta última oferta y los llamamos a votar la huelga", agregó. Sin embargo, de rechazarse la oferta las partes tendrán una mediación obligatoria gubernamental de cinco días -que puede ser extendida por otros cinco días de mutuo acuerdo-, antes de estar habilitados para iniciar una paralización legal. Los trabajadores han rechazado algunos puntos planteados por la empresa como realizar labores de faenas y la posibilidad de habilitarse un turno de 14-14 días de trabajo/descanso en contingencias. La compañía dijo tras entregar la oferta que la misma "contiene mejoras y nuevos beneficios sobre el actual contrato colectivo, el cual ya es un instrumento líder en la industria para el segmento de supervisores y staff, según distintos análisis comparativos con el mercado minero". Escondida agregó que el nuevo contrato vendrá en un periodo "marcado por menores niveles de producción, presión sobre los costos y la ejecución de un plan de inversiones para mantener su capacidad productiva hacia el futuro".

item.title: Surging Pirates set sights on silencing Cardinals in rematch
item.description: The Pittsburgh Pirates were eliminated from playoff contention last week, but they appear determined to head into the offseason on a high note.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Pittsburgh Pirates were eliminated from playoff contention last week, but they appear determined to head into the offseason on a high note. The Pirates (80-77) will seek their season-high sixth straight victory on Wednesday night when they continue a three-game series against the visiting St. Louis Cardinals (76-81). Jared Jones and two relievers combined on a one-hitter in Pittsburgh's 2-0 win in the series opener on Tuesday. The Pirates broke a scoreless tie with two outs in the sixth inning on Ryan O'Hearn's RBI single. St. Louis was stymied at the plate by Jones, who lowered his ERA to 1.08 in four September starts and allowed one hit with nine strikeouts and no walks over seven innings. "(The Pirates) pitch really well," St. Louis manager Oliver Marmol said. "They have a lot of arms in the rotation and the bullpen. We ran into one today; Jones did a really nice job. Lot of swing and miss. We couldn't put a whole lot in play against him." The Pirates have gone 15-6 in their last 21 games and are two wins away from finishing a season with a winning record for the first time since going 82-79 in 2018. Catcher Rafael Flores Jr. has reached base safely in 15 consecutive games for the Pirates, who have set a single-season franchise record with 181 home runs. While Pittsburgh will miss the playoffs for the 11th straight season, O'Hearn said the pieces are in place for a promising future. "This definitely feels like a group to build off of," O'Hearn told the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette. "I'm not the GM; I don't make those decisions in the offseason, but it definitely feels like a group that's building together moving forward. Doesn't feel like the end. I've been on teams where it kind of felt like the end of an era type of thing, but this feels like a team that you want to build forward with." The Pirates will use a bullpen game on Wednesday, with right-hander Lake Bachar (1-4, 3.56 ERA) getting the start. Bachar pitched an inning as the opener on Sunday, allowing one run on three hits against the Kansas City Royals. He is 0-2 with a 2.92 ERA in 13 games since being acquired from the Miami Marlins on Aug. 3. St. Louis will counter with left-hander Matthew Liberatore (5-14, 5.36 ERA), who pitched six innings of one-run ball in a no-decision against the San Francisco Giants last Wednesday. St. Louis lost 6-5 in 10 innings. Liberatore, 26, has struggled to build on his success from last season, when he posted a 4.21 ERA over 151 2/3 innings. "It's certainly not the season I wanted or the season anyone was expecting me to have," Liberatore said. "But I'm grateful for what I've gone through this year. I think it's really forced me to understand myself better and understand my identity and what I need to do to be successful at this level." Oneil Cruz is 4-for-17 (.235) and Bryan Reynolds is 6-for-18 (.333) with a home run against Liberatore, who is 2-4 with a 5.60 ERA in 12 career games (eight starts) vs. Pittsburgh, including 0-1 with a 6.10 mark in two outings this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: LA28 da a conocer los recorridos del triatlón de Venice Beach para los Juegos Olímpicos de 2028
item.description: Los organizadores de Los Ángeles 2028 dieron a conocer el miércoles los recorridos preliminares de triatlón para los Juegos Olímpicos y Paralímpicos, situando las pruebas en Venice Beach con una línea de meta común con vistas al océano Pacífico.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: Los organizadores de Los Ángeles 2028 dieron a conocer el miércoles los recorridos preliminares de triatlón para los Juegos Olímpicos y Paralímpicos, situando las pruebas en Venice Beach con una línea de meta común con vistas al océano Pacífico. Los recorridos, que aún están sujetos a pruebas operativas, contarán con una zona de transición central cerca de la playa, lo que permitirá a los espectadores ver cómo los atletas pasan de la natación al ciclismo y a la carrera a pie. Los organizadores afirmaron que los recorridos de ciclismo y carrera a pie, en general llanos, se han diseñado para favorecer un ritmo de carrera rápido. El triatlón individual femenino de los Juegos está programado para el 15 de julio y será la primera prueba en la que se entregarán medallas de LA28. La carrera individual masculina tendrá lugar al día siguiente, y el relevo mixto está previsto para el 20 de julio. En las pruebas individuales, los competidores comienzan con un recorrido de natación en el océano de 1,5 kilómetros, entrando al agua directamente desde la playa en lugar de desde un pontón. La prueba de natación constará de una vuelta de 1.000 metros, seguida de una breve carrera por la playa y una segunda vuelta de 500 m. A continuación, los atletas completarán ocho vueltas de 5 kilómetros en bicicleta, que incluirán tramos por la ciclovía de Venice Beach y por las calles de la ciudad, antes de una carrera a pie de cuatro vueltas y 10 km que cruzará los puentes de la zona de los canales de Venice. El relevo mixto contará con equipos de cuatro atletas que competirán en un orden alterno de mujer-hombre-mujer-hombre. Cada atleta nadará 350 m, recorrerá 6,6 km en bicicleta y correrá 1,6 km antes de pasar el relevo a un compañero de equipo. Las pruebas individuales paralímpicas, previstas para los días 18 y 19 de agosto de 2028, incluirán un recorrido de natación de 750 m con salida desde una barcaza situada más allá del rompeolas, seguido de un recorrido en bicicleta de 20 km y una carrera a pie de 5 km. Las pruebas contarán con atletas de seis categorías deportivas. LA28 ha indicado que los recorridos se pondrán a prueba durante una prueba del Circuito Mundial de Triatlón T50 de la World Triathlon, que se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio de 2027.

item.title: Dramatic eviction of 87-year-old Madrid tenant spotlights Spain's housing crisis
item.description: Police evicted an 87-year-old woman on Wednesday from her Madrid home of more than seven decades despite hundreds of people protesting outside and the government criticising the eviction order, in a dramatic new flashpoint of Spain's housing crisis.
item.dc:creator: Corina Pons
item.content:encoded: Police evicted an 87-year-old woman on Wednesday from her Madrid home of more than seven decades despite hundreds of people protesting outside and the government criticising the eviction order, in a dramatic new flashpoint of Spain's housing crisis. After being given just 30 minutes to leave with only essential belongings, Maricarmen Abascal was eventually removed from the building on a stretcher accompanied by social services officials and driven away in an ambulance as supporters chanted "Maricarmen, you're not alone!" and "Murderers!" The case highlights mounting pressure on long-term tenants in major Spanish cities, where soaring rents, gentrification and a shortage of affordable housing have fuelled social and political tensions. The apartment in the capital's affluent Retiro neighbourhood had been acquired by an investment fund that sought a steep increase in her rent. Maricarmen's lawyer, Beatriz Duro, said court officials and representatives of the investment fund, Urbagestion, had refused to suspend the eviction despite a pending court filing, humanitarian appeals and evidence that public authorities were working to secure alternative accommodation. Urbagestion did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Duro said an anonymous individual had offered to cover the rent payments, but the landlord declined to sign a new lease. "I've lived here for 71 years and I don't want to leave," Maricarmen told reporters on the eve of the eviction. The eviction sparked tense scenes outside the building, where police forcibly removed protesters blocking the entrance. Reuters witnesses saw officers dragging and pushing demonstrators, lifting some by their arms and legs as they cleared the doorway. Spain remains divided over how to tackle a worsening housing affordability crisis. The left-wing coalition government has pushed for stronger tenant protections and wider rent controls, but has struggled to secure backing in a divided parliament, while the conservative-led Madrid regional government has favoured a more market-oriented approach. Madrid's regional leader, Isabel Diaz Ayuso, is embroiled in a scandal regarding her government's purchase, via a public real estate agency, of a €6.3 million ($7.2 million) luxury penthouse. The opposition accuses Ayuso of seeking to use the property as her personal residence while bypassing public spending and transparency rules, which she denies. Referring to that scandal, activists at Wednesday's eviction shouted: "Ayuso's penthouse for Maricarmen!" ($1 = 0.8763 euros)

item.title: Seleccionador de Irlanda agradece al primer ministro su apoyo de cara a los partidos contra Israel
item.description: El seleccionador de Irlanda, Heimir Hallgrimsson, agradeció el apoyo del primer ministro del país después de que sus comentarios recibieran una contundente respuesta por parte de la Federación Israelí de Fútbol, mientras los próximos partidos entre ambas naciones siguen acaparando los titulares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El seleccionador de Irlanda, Heimir Hallgrimsson, agradeció el apoyo del primer ministro del país después de que sus comentarios recibieran una contundente respuesta por parte de la Federación Israelí de Fútbol, mientras los próximos partidos entre ambas naciones siguen acaparando los titulares. El equipo de Hallgrimsson se enfrentará a Kosovo el jueves en su primer partido de la Liga de Naciones, pero ese encuentro pasó a un segundo plano en lo que respecta al interés de los medios de comunicación y del público. El partido del domingo contra Israel, que se disputará a domicilio, tendrá lugar en terreno neutral, en Debrecen (Hungría), ante un reducido número de aficionados israelíes. La Federación de Fútbol de Irlanda (FAI) trasladó el partido en casa, previsto para el 4 de octubre, a Serbia. Ese encuentro se jugará a puerta cerrada. El fin de semana, Hallgrimsson afirmó: "No jugamos con el genocidio, jugamos contra el genocidio", y el lunes la Federación Israelí de Fútbol respondió: "No jugamos con la ignorancia, la hipocresía y la estupidez, jugamos contra el entrenador que las encarna". El primer ministro irlandés, Micheal Martin, defendió a Hallgrimsson al hablar con los periodistas el martes, calificando las declaraciones de Israel de "inaceptables" y añadiendo que "Israel no puede seguir negando lo que el mundo sabe". La rueda de prensa del miércoles previa al partido contra Kosovo comenzó con una pregunta sobre los comentarios del primer ministro. "Lo que dije en la última rueda de prensa ha desviado la atención de lo que quizá sea lo más importante: vamos a disputar un partido importante contra Kosovo", afirmó Hallgrimsson. "Quizá, desde el punto de vista del liderazgo, no haya sido muy acertado por mi parte desviar la atención de esta manera. Pero, para responder a la pregunta, estamos agradecidos por todo el apoyo que recibimos. Es un momento delicado para nosotros", comentó. Irlanda ha sido uno de los críticos más abiertos de Europa respecto a la guerra de Israel en Gaza, y los miembros de la FAI votaron en noviembre a favor de que su junta directiva solicitara a la UEFA la suspensión de Israel de las competiciones europeas. El ataque de Israel a Gaza ha sido calificado de genocidio por expertos de la ONU y organizaciones de derechos humanos, una acusación que Israel rechaza. Se han producido numerosas protestas en Irlanda en los días previos a los partidos y el miércoles se le preguntó al capitán Dara O’Shea si los jugadores tenían prevista alguna acción para los partidos contra Israel. "Nos reuniremos el viernes para debatirlo en grupo", afirmó O’Shea. "No creo que estuviéramos haciendo bien nuestro trabajo si no nos centráramos en el partido (contra Kosovo). Es algo que no se puede pasar por alto. La decisión a la que lleguemos como jugadores se tomará de forma unánime". La cadena pública irlandesa RTE, que tiene la obligación contractual de retransmitir los partidos, ofrecerá una cobertura reducida. No habrá presentación en estudio ni análisis de expertos, y los comentarios se tomarán de la señal internacional. La RTE no ha aceptado publicidad ni patrocinios para ninguno de los dos partidos.

item.title: Musk elogia Xi como grande líder em entrevista à televisão estatal chinesa
item.description: O presidente-executivo da Tesla, Elon Musk, elogiou o presidente chinês Xi Jinping como um “grande líder” em declarações feitas durante uma entrevista à rede de televisão estatal chinesa CCTV na quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente-executivo da Tesla, Elon Musk, elogiou o presidente chinês Xi Jinping como um “grande líder” em declarações feitas durante uma entrevista à rede de televisão estatal chinesa CCTV na quarta-feira. “Sob sua gestão, a China prosperou imensamente”, disse Musk, citando o progresso visível nos novos edifícios e nas infraestruturas construídas no país. “Também é óbvio perceber, simplesmente andando pelas ruas, o aumento da prosperidade do cidadão chinês comum”, acrescentou ele. Musk deve se juntar a outros executivos dos EUA em um jantar de Estado na Casa Branca oferecido pelo presidente Donald Trump em homenagem a Xi na quinta-feira, informou a Reuters. Xi vai se reunir com Trump na quinta-feira na segunda cúpula deste ano entre os líderes das duas maiores economias do mundo. Musk também comentou sobre o maior centro de produção da Tesla, localizado em Xangai, descrevendo a equipe como “incrivelmente talentosa, trabalhadora e confiável”. “A fábrica da Tesla em Xangai é uma joia e é linda”, disse ele. Musk já havia descartado especulações de que as operações da Tesla na China poderiam ser separadas antes de uma possível fusão com a SpaceX. As vendas dos veículos Model 3 e Model Y produzidos na fábrica da Tesla em Xangai — que também é seu maior centro de exportação global — aumentaram 3,6% na comparação anual em agosto, apresentando uma desaceleração acentuada em relação ao mês anterior, à medida que tendências divergentes persistiram nos principais mercados da montadora norte-americana.

item.title: BCE dice que la UE podría recuperar un tercio de la ventaja económica de EEUU con mayores empresas
item.description: La Unión Europea podría reducir un tercio de su brecha de productividad con Estados Unidos si contara con el mismo número de grandes empresas, según afirmó el miércoles el Banco Central Europeo, sumándose así a las peticiones de reformas que faciliten el crecimiento de las compañías.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Unión Europea podría reducir un tercio de su brecha de productividad con Estados Unidos si contara con el mismo número de grandes empresas, según afirmó el miércoles el Banco Central Europeo, sumándose así a las peticiones de reformas que faciliten el crecimiento de las compañías. Los responsables políticos europeos están tratando de hacer frente al bajo rendimiento económico de la UE en comparación con Estados Unidos, donde se encuentran muchas de las empresas más grandes del mundo y que lidera la carrera por el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial. Según estudios académicos, los trabajadores de la UE producen un 20% menos por hora que sus homólogos estadounidenses. En 1995, ambos estaban prácticamente a la par. Los expertos del BCE constataron que, si Europa tuviera la misma distribución de grandes y pequeñas compañías que Estados Unidos —sin modificar la productividad de cada tipo de empresa—, la brecha de productividad se reduciría en cerca de un tercio. Las grandes empresas son mucho más productivas que las pequeñas. Las que tienen al menos 250 empleados generan una media de 86.800 euros de valor añadido por trabajador al año, mientras que de menos de 10 empleados producen menos de la mitad de esa cantidad. El BCE señaló que los peores resultados de Europa en materia de productividad también reflejan un menor nivel de innovación, una regulación fragmentada y unos mercados de capitales menos desarrollados, factores que dificultan el crecimiento de las empresas y su capacidad para competir a nivel internacional. El banco central respaldó el marco propuesto "EU Inc", un régimen de derecho mercantil a escala del bloque destinado a reducir las barreras a la actividad empresarial transfronteriza. Inspirándose vagamente en el marco societario de Delaware (Estados Unidos), EU Inc crearía una estructura jurídica única que operaría en todo el bloque, eludiendo el mosaico de 27 sistemas nacionales de derecho de sociedades y docenas de formas jurídicas. "EU Inc. tiene el potencial de reforzar el Mercado Único, potenciando la competencia, la innovación y el crecimiento de la productividad", afirmó el BCE.

item.title: Número de mortos em naufrágio aumenta na Indonésia e seguem buscas por 107 desaparecidos
item.description: O número de mortos no naufrágio de um navio de passageiros que virou e afundou na costa da Indonésia há 10 dias subiu para 28 nesta quarta-feira, segundo autoridades, e as equipes de resgate esperam encontrar mais corpos à medida que ampliam as buscas subaquáticas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O número de mortos no naufrágio de um navio de passageiros que virou e afundou na costa da Indonésia há 10 dias subiu para 28 nesta quarta-feira, segundo autoridades, e as equipes de resgate esperam encontrar mais corpos à medida que ampliam as buscas subaquáticas. A balsa Virgo Transport 8 transportava 243 pessoas, incluindo 30 tripulantes e um número desconhecido de veículos, quando virou devido ao mau tempo na madrugada de 13 de setembro, durante uma viagem de Surabaya, em Java Oriental, para Banjarmasin, em Kalimantan do Sul. Membros da Guarda Costeira e da Marinha recuperaram 16 corpos de dentro do navio nos últimos três dias, sendo que nove foram encontrados nesta quarta-feira. Mais dois corpos foram levados pela correnteza até a costa a cerca de 253 km do local do acidente, informou o chefe da Agência Nacional de Resgate, Mohammad Syafii. Até quarta-feira, o número total confirmado de mortos era de 28, com 107 pessoas ainda desaparecidas. Havia 108 sobreviventes confirmados. As operações de busca e resgate foram prorrogadas até 27 de setembro. As autoridades informaram que os esforços para endireitar o navio estavam em andamento, mas ele continuava virado na quarta-feira.

item.title: Aumentan a 28 los muertos de naufragio de barco en Indonesia, se amplía búsqueda de 107 desaparecidos
item.description: El número de muertos del naufragio de un buque de pasajeros que se hundió frente a las costas de Indonesia hace 10 días ascendió el miércoles a 28, informaron las autoridades, y los equipos de rescate prevén encontrar más cadáveres a medida que amplían la búsqueda submarina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El número de muertos del naufragio de un buque de pasajeros que se hundió frente a las costas de Indonesia hace 10 días ascendió el miércoles a 28, informaron las autoridades, y los equipos de rescate prevén encontrar más cadáveres a medida que amplían la búsqueda submarina. El transbordador "Virgo Transport 8" llevaba a 243 personas, entre ellas 30 tripulantes y un número indeterminado de vehículos, cuando zozobró debido al mal tiempo en la madrugada del 13 de septiembre, durante un trayecto desde Surabaya, en Java Oriental, hasta Banjarmasin, en Kalimantan del Sur. El personal de la guardia costera y de la Armada ha recuperado 16 cadáveres del interior del barco en los últimos tres días, nueve de ellos hallados el miércoles. Otros dos cadáveres habían sido arrastrados hasta la costa a unos 253 km (157 millas) del lugar del accidente, dijo el director de la Agencia Nacional de Rescate, Mohammad Syafii. Hasta el miércoles, el número total de fallecidos confirmados ascendía a 28, con 107 personas aún desaparecidas. Se contabilizaban 108 supervivientes. Las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate se han prolongado hasta el 27 de septiembre. Las autoridades indicaron que se estaban llevando a cabo esfuerzos para enderezar el barco, pero este seguía volcado el miércoles. La búsqueda del miércoles se centró en localizar más cadáveres en los camarotes del barco, explicó I Putu Sudayana, jefe de la agencia de rescate de Banjarmasin. Los buzos rompieron las ventanas de los camarotes el martes, pero no pudieron entrar debido a la turbidez del agua y a las fuertes corrientes, lo que hizo imposible recuperar los cadáveres que se habían avistado. "Nuestra búsqueda submarina se centra en el casco del barco. Ahí es donde estamos concentrando nuestros esfuerzos porque hemos encontrado a muchos pasajeros atrapados dentro de los camarotes", afirmó. Posteriormente, si es posible, los equipos de rescate trasladarán la búsqueda a los vehículos que se encontraban en el transbordador, aunque esto podría resultar complicado, ya que muchos parecen estar amontonados unos encima de otros. "Esto supone un riesgo para el equipo de buceo", señaló Putu. "Si es factible y seguro, llevaremos a cabo la búsqueda".

item.title: Bce: Ue potrebbe recuperare un terzo del vantaggio economico Usa con più grandi imprese
item.description: L'Unione europea potrebbe colmare un terzo del proprio divario di produttività rispetto agli Stati Uniti se disponesse dello stesso numero di grandi imprese.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Unione europea potrebbe colmare un terzo del proprio divario di produttività rispetto agli Stati Uniti se disponesse dello stesso numero di grandi imprese. Lo ha affermato la Banca centrale europea, unendosi al coro di richieste per riforme volte a facilitare la crescita delle imprese. Gli esponenti politici europei stanno cercando di affrontare la sottoperformance economica dell’Ue in confronto con gli Stati Uniti, dove hanno sede molte delle più grandi aziende del mondo e in testa alla corsa per lo sviluppo dell’intelligenza artificiale. Secondo alcuni studi accademici, i lavoratori dell’Unione producono il 20% in meno all’ora rispetto alle controparti statunitensi, mentre nel 1995 i livelli erano quasi equivalenti. Gli esperti della Bce hanno rilevato che se l’Europa avesse la stessa distribuzione di grandi e piccole imprese degli Stati Uniti – senza modificare il livello di produttività di ciascuna tipologia di azienda – il divario di produttività si ridurrebbe di circa un terzo. La produttività delle grandi imprese è nettamente maggiore di quelle più piccole: le aziende con almeno 250 dipendenti generano in media 86.800 euro di valore aggiunto per lavoratore all’anno, mentre quelle con meno di 10 dipendenti ne producono meno della metà. La Bce ha affermato che i più deboli risultati dell’Europa in termini di produttività riflettono anche una minore innovazione, una regolamentazione frammentata e mercati dei capitali meno sviluppati, tutti fattori che rendono più difficile per le imprese crescere e competere su scala internazionale. La banca centrale ha sostenuto il quadro proposto denominato "EU Inc", un regime di diritto societario a livello europeo volto a ridurre le barriere all’attività commerciale transfrontaliera. Ispirato liberamente al quadro societario del Delaware negli Stati Uniti, l’EU Inc. andrebbe a creare un’unica struttura giuridica operante in tutta l'Unione, aggirando la frammentazione data dai 27 sistemi nazionali di diritto societario e decine di forme d'impresa. "EU Inc. ha il potenziale per sostenere il Mercato Unico, rafforzando la concorrenza, l’innovazione e la crescita della produttività", ha affermato la Bce.

item.title: Glencore to create US strategic critical minerals reserve with EXIM Bank
item.description: Glencore on Wednesday said it received a $500 million commitment from Export-Import Bank of the United States to create a strategic critical minerals reserve to strengthen supply chains in the US.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Glencore (GLEN.L) on Wednesday said it received a $500 million commitment from Export-Import Bank of the United States to create a strategic critical minerals reserve to strengthen supply chains in the US. VaultCo, the public-private partnership between the global miner and the US government agency, will enable Glencore to source, procure, and deliver critical minerals to the US, and reduce any future disruptions to the country's supply of critical minerals, the company said.

item.title: HSBC lifts STOXX 600 year-end target on stronger earnings outlook
item.description: HSBC lifted its year-end target for Europe's STOXX 600 index for the first time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger earnings growth prospects, improving business sentiment and a healthier economic outlook.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: HSBC lifted its year-end target for Europe's STOXX 600 index (.STOXX) for the first time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger earnings growth prospects, improving business sentiment and a healthier economic outlook. The brokerage expects the index to reach 680 points by year-end from its previous forecast of 670, implying about 6.3% upside from current levels, and to reach 760 by the end of next year. HSBC is the latest brokerage to turn more optimistic on European equities, as investors look past geopolitical risks and focus on the region's ability to withstand recent economic and energy shocks. Recent data have also eased concerns that [USN:L6N45F0DA TEXT:"geopolitical tensions"] would significantly derail growth. London-based HSBC forecasts European earnings growth of 15.6% in 2026 and 15.4% in 2027. The brokerage said European companies are becoming increasingly domestically focused, with regional revenue exposure rising to its highest level since 2017, somewhat shielding them from currency movements even as overseas sales still account for about half of revenue. A weakness of the euro and other European currencies against the US dollar could provide an additional tailwind for corporate profits, HSBC added. The brokerage upgraded Italy to "overweight" from "neutral", citing lower reliance on Middle Eastern gas imports, while downgrading France to "underweight" on weaker economic forecasts and deteriorating consensus estimates. HSBC also raised its year-end target for Britain's FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) to 11,390 from 10,980, implying nearly 6.5% upside from current levels.

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Elicottero militare russo sconfina spazio aereo Polonia
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina: 14.05 - Un elicottero militare russo Mi-8 ha effettuato una breve incursione nello spazio aereo della Polonia, Paese membro della Nato, partendo dall’exclave russa di Kaliningrad. Lo ha reso noto il Comando operativo dell’esercito polacco. L’elicottero ha trascorso 42 secondi nello spazio aereo polacco, penetrando fino ad una estensione di circa 300 metri, ha scritto il Comando su X. "Sono stati fatti decollare aerei da caccia, mentre le forze e i mezzi di terra sono rimasti in stato di allerta. La natura dell’episodio indica che la Russia sta ancora una volta mettendo alla prova la prontezza della nostra difesa aerea", ha aggiunto 11.35 - Il Cremlino ha affermato oggi che non sussistono ancora i presupposti per l’avvio di colloqui di pace sull’Ucraina, pur rimanendo aperto a tali trattative. Intervenendo in vista di un incontro previsto a New York tra il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio e il ministro degli Esteri russo Sergey Lavrov, ha detto che non vi sono piani concreti per incontri ad alto livello né con Washington né con Kiev al fine di discutere un potenziale accordo di pace. Il portavoce del Cremlino Dmitry Peskov ha affermato che non è cambiata nemmeno la posizione della Russia riguardo alla possibilità di un incontro di persona tra il presidente Vladimir Putin e il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky. "Zelensky, se lo desidera, può venire a Mosca. Gli saranno fornite le necessarie garanzie di sicurezza", ha detto Peskov, aggiungendo che il presidente ucraino è consapevole delle decisioni che deve prendere, secondo Mosca. Le autorità ucraine hanno ripetutamente affermato che un incontro a Mosca non sarebbe accettabile e hanno proposto invece di tenere colloqui diretti in un paese neutrale.

item.title: Analysis-There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% interest rates
item.description: By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage WASHINGTON, Sept 23 (Reuters) - As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, P...
item.dc:creator: By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded:
Analysis-There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% interest rates

FILE PHOTO: View of the facade as construction continues on the Federal Reserve Board building, in Washington, D.C., U.S., September 17, 2025. REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo · Reuters By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage Wed, September 23, 2026 at 8:37 AM EDT 5 min read

By Howard Schneider and Jacob Bogage WASHINGTON, Sept 23 (Reuters) - As a lifelong real estate investor whose businesses relied on debt and interest rates, President Donald Trump might be expected to know better: The 1% rate he keeps demanding from the US Federal Reserve is impractical and would likely backfire, according to analysts.

A policy rate slashed that low, from its current range of 3.75% to 4%, would likely touch off massive dislocation in the global financial system and end up with the US government paying more to borrow than it does now in bond markets. Some figures close to the president say his interest rate demands should be seen less as a prescription and more as a way to deflect from issues like high consumer prices ahead of midterm elections in November. But in practical terms, a 3-percentage-point cut by the Fed "seems cataclysmic," said J. Benson Durham, founder of DASM investment research firm. Treasury rates would climb as investors priced higher inflation, countries like Germany could soak up capital by offering just a bit more to lenders than the US, and the dollar would "plummet," he said. Yet despite the bond market math and concerns about Fed credibility, Trump has repeatedly called for ultra-low borrowing costs, which he says the US deserves as the world's largest economy with, he argues, the safest credit.

TRUMP'S DEMANDS After the Fed under its relatively new chair, Kevin Warsh, hiked rates last week, Trump criticized the decision and repeated the 1% figure. "The president in his own way is saying, 'I don't like the pain of this,' but he should be clear that it's not the fault of the Fed" for having to raise rates, said Grover Norquist, head of the conservative group Americans for Tax Reform, and an outside Trump economic adviser. Given the importance of controlling inflation ahead of the vote, some allies of the administration privately praised Warsh after the rate decision, according to one person involved in the exchanges, who requested anonymity to discuss them. A White House ally who liaises with Warsh told Reuters the calls for 1% are unrealistic given the workings of global bond markets. "Can everybody just wake up? If you mess up the bond market, it's good for the bond investor and no one else," said the person. The White House did not respond to requests for comment. The Fed did not comment on Trump's remarks.

HIGH INFLATION AHEAD OF VOTE Trump's pressure on the Fed goes beyond the 1% rate request. He aims to oust Governor Lisa Cook, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, and is awaiting results of an inspector general's probe of former Chair Jerome Powell's oversight of a Fed construction project. Powell remains a Fed governor, denying Trump a new appointee at the central bank.

Story Continues Some analysts say the Fed remains a useful scapegoat for Trump, who heads into the midterms with mortgage rates nearing 7% and prices for staples like ground beef and gasoline also rising, underlining the issue of affordability. Inflation has increased since early in Trump's term from the combined shocks of his tariffs and energy costs from the US war with Iran, among other things. The Fed's preferred inflation measure was 3.7% in July and the bank doesn't expect that rate to fall to a 2% target before 2029, suggesting inflation could remain elevated for Trump's entire term.

TONE SHIFT The president's public comments have mostly spared Warsh, his handpicked successor to Powell, and focused more on the Fed's other policymakers. When Powell as chair ignored Trump's various calls to cut rates or not raise them, the president called him an "enemy," a "numb skull" and other epithets. By contrast last week, Trump characterized Warsh as being boxed in by a "political" board. After the Fed lifted rates for the first time in three years, in a unanimous vote, Trump said that he had told Warsh in a phone call beforehand to go along with the majority if necessary. Warsh has said he won't discuss conversations with Trump. Long considered an inflation hawk, Warsh had weeks ago laid out the case for higher rates, surprising some analysts who had questioned his independence from Trump. Warsh "has repeatedly said the Fed will deliver price stability. Wednesday's rate hike shows that he means it," Apollo Global Chief Economist Torsten Slok said after the Fed's Sept. 16 decision.

KEEPING AN OPEN LINE The relative leeway Trump is giving Warsh may reflect their warmer ties early in the new Fed chief's term. Trump started chiding Powell early in his first presidency for raising rates, and the relationship remained tense. Powell did not openly push back against the rhetoric until early this year, when the administration sent a grand jury subpoena over the construction project. Warsh appears to have a more congenial relationship, fielding the president's phone calls while maintaining he'll remain an independent broker when it comes to monetary policy. That policy now includes a hardening stance against inflation. Polls show that pocketbook issues including record diesel fuel prices are hitting red state rural economies and small businesses, and that Trump's record-low approval rating is dragging down Republican congressional candidates. A Reuters/IPSOS poll published Monday showed just 17% of respondents approve of the president's handling of the cost-of-living, the top issue Americans say will influence how they vote in six weeks. (Reporting by Howard Schneider; Editing by Dan Burns and Jonathan Spicer)

item.title: Civil society groups urge Malaysia to stop Rohingya returns
item.description: More than 160 civil society organisations released a joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: More than 160 civil society organisations released a joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription. The groups expressed "grave concerns" over Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's proposal to seek Myanmar junta leader-turned-president Min Aung Hlaing's cooperation to send back Rohingya, a Muslim-minority community long persecuted in Myanmar. The Malaysian government was not immediately available for comment. Malaysia had around [USN:L4N44E069 TEXT:"193,800 refugees"] from Myanmar - including large numbers of Rohingya - as of February, according to the United Nations and the country says it plans to return 1,500 refugees on September 29 in a [USN:L6N44O0RX TEXT:"first phase"]. Malaysia [USN:L6N4580O7 TEXT:"said"] Myanmar has agreed to take back 5,000 refugees without specifying if they were Rohingya. Anwar has [USN:L6N4580O7 TEXT:"said"] he plans to invite Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing to Malaysia in return for accepting Rohingya refugees. The statement said Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing is the "architect of genocide" against Rohingya for the military crackdown on the community, with the International Criminal Court currently weighing an arrest warrant against him. Myanmar, which does not recognize Rohingya as an ethnic group, has previously said its military actions in Rakhine state that drove out large numbers of Rohingya were in response to militant attacks. The groups warned that upon returning to Myanmar, Rohingya could face forced conscription into multiple armed groups, including the military, the Arakan Army (AA), and the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA). Thousands of persecuted Rohingya flee Myanmar each year, often risking dangerous journeys on rickety boats and overland routes. Myanmar's military is [USN:L1N3XH0H5 TEXT:"fighting"] the Arakan Army, an ethnic armed group based in Rakhine state — from where large numbers of Rohingya have been driven out — that is seeking greater autonomy for the region.

item.title: UBS BB reitera compra para ação da Petrobras e eleva preço-alvo
item.description: Analistas do UBS BB elevaram o preço-alvo para as ações da Petrobras para R$62 ante R$60 e reiteraram recomendação de compra para os papéis, citando que a tese de investimento na companhia se destaca sob as perspectivas macro e micro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Analistas do UBS BB elevaram o preço-alvo para as ações da Petrobras (PETR3.SA) para R$62 ante R$60 e reiteraram recomendação de compra para os papéis, citando que a tese de investimento na companhia se destaca sob as perspectivas macro e micro. Tasso Vasconcellos e equipe chamaram a atenção para a elevada exposição ao petróleo, beneficiada pelo fato de a companhia ser exportadora líquida, sem grandes impactos operacionais decorrentes dos conflitos no Oriente Médio, enquanto a produção tem surpreendido positivamente, com o ritmo atual à frente do plano da estatal. Eles ponderaram que o negócio de refino ainda está abaixo dos níveis que gostariam de ver -- entre pares da América Latina, América do Norte e Europa, no segundo trimestre, a Petrobras foi a única empresa que apresentou queda trimestral no Ebitda por barril no segmento --, mas apontaram que o programa de subsídios do governo oferece algum suporte. Tais elementos, combinados com uma política clara de dividendos trimestrais diretamente vinculada ao fluxo de caixa, resultam em um yield de dividendo de 10% a 11% em 2026, aumentando para 13% a 14% em 2027, colocando a Petrobras "entre as empresas com maiores yields de dividendos entre seus pares globais e sustentando nossa perspectiva positiva", afirmaram em relatório a clientes com data de terça-feira. Na véspera, as ações preferenciais da Petrobras fecharam a R$48,35 e os papéis ordinários foram cotados a R$53,20. Em 2026, ambos acumulam valorizações de 66,76% e 72,55%, respectivamente.

item.title: India tightens proposal to roll out food warning labels for packaged products
item.description: India's food safety authority on Wednesday tightened its proposed warning labels for packaged products, saying they would be applicable even if one nutrient of concern – salt, sugar or fat – was high, according to a court filing seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's food safety authority on Wednesday tightened its proposed warning labels for packaged products, saying they would be applicable even if one nutrient of concern – salt, sugar or fat – was high, according to a court filing seen by Reuters. Earlier, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India had said it would roll out the red warning labels over two phases, with the first phase only triggering a warning mark when two concerning nutrients were high in quantity. That proposal has been dropped, and the warning labels will be rolled out in a single phase now, the FSSAI told India's Supreme Court, which is hearing pleas of health activists. The filing is not public but was seen by Reuters.
