item.title: Yu completes hat-trick of gold in fairytale Asian Games debut
item.description: Three golds in three events, each with a benchmark timing — the script could not have been written any better for Chinese swimming sensation Yu Zidi, who capped her fairytale Asian Games debut in style on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Amlan Chakraborty
item.content:encoded: Three golds in three events, each with a benchmark timing — the script could not have been written any better for Chinese swimming sensation Yu Zidi, who capped her fairytale Asian Games debut in style on Wednesday. Having already shaken the swimming world by winning the 200m butterfly and 200m individual medley, the 13-year-old erased any lingering doubts about her generational talent with a dominant victory in the 400m individual medley, further tightening China's grip on the medals table. Yu's wire-to-wire win, clocked at four minutes and 28.56 seconds, set a new Games record and came comfortably 3.95 seconds ahead of compatriot Ke Wenxi. "I am very happy. I have gained a lot from these Asian Games, but there are also some regrets," Yu said. "I will go back and review what I did not do well. Hopefully, I can do better next time." China's butterfly queen Zhang Yufei was the latest to gush about Yu, who is already tipped for a duel with Canadian Summer McIntosh at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. "I've only seen her at the National Games so far but seeing her results get better and better it makes me really happy," Zhang told Reuters. "I also hope this little girl can maintain her trajectory... It will be interesting to see how high she can go. "I think everyone's been surprised seeing what she has done in these two years. It seems every competition she reaches a higher level. Now everyone wonders what's next?" Elsewhere in the pool, Peng Xuwei claimed the women's 100m backstroke title, even though she was "not particularly satisfied" with how she swam, while Zhang Zhanshuo powered to victory in the men's 200m freestyle to bag his fourth gold of the ongoing Games. PARIS REVENGE The day also brought a measure of revenge for China over Japan, [USN:L6N45F0BP TEXT:"avenging"] their defeat at the Paris Olympics two years ago after Zhang Boheng produced a nerveless display on the high bar to seal the men's team gymnastics gold. It marked the second time Zhang had turned the tables on Japan at the Aichi-Nagoya Games, having already edged out Shinnosuke Oka for the all-around title — just two years after finishing runner-up to him in Paris. "Looking back now, I would not call Paris a regret," Zhang said. "It was one stage in my gymnastics career. I learned a great deal there and took a great deal from it, and I used it to work on my shortcomings, right up to taking this gold medal today." On the track, athletics powerhouse China opened their campaign in style, sweeping the half-marathon race walk. Shi Shengji broke clear after the 10km mark and never looked back, the 19-year-old overpowering Japan's world record holder Yamanishi Toshikazu. Yang Liujing claimed the women's gold after compatriot Jiang Yunyan, who had been running neck and neck, was penalised and demoted to bronze. In weightlifting, North Korea's Ri Song Gum shattered three world records on her way to a third Asian Games gold. The 28-year-old lifted 94kg in the snatch and 121kg in the clean-and-jerk for a combined total of 215kg, resetting all three benchmarks in the women's 49kg category. "The world record and this gold medal hold great meaning for me, because of everything I poured into this competition," Ri said after securing North Korea's first gold of the Aichi-Nagoya Games. On the road, Kazakhstan's Alexey Lutsenko bowed out of the Asian Games in style, claiming his second gold in Nagoya with victory in the men's road race. Lutsenko, who will retire from cycling at the end of the year, had already won gold in the men's individual time trial and signs off with an impressive haul of seven Asian Games medals.

item.title: What's the latest with semiconductor export controls?
item.description: Anthony Rapa of Blank Rome LLP discusses recent developments in U.S. export controls on semiconductors for AI, covering the AI Diffusion Rule, policy shifts for China and the UAE, and remote computing challenges.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Rapa
item.content:encoded: As much of the world goes all-in on building out artificial intelligence ("AI") infrastructure, companies continue to navigate strict U.S. export controls over the advanced semiconductors and computing items that power AI. Any company looking to set up or supply an AI data center must take into account these export controls, which can make or break a project based on the level of access to advanced chips they permit. There have been significant twists and turns in this area of late, including: •the Trump Administration's announcement that it would no longer enforce the Biden Administration's "AI Diffusion Rule"; •a patchwork of targeted changes regarding China's access to advanced chips; •a significant upgrade in the export control status of the United Arab Emirates; and •challenges associated with Chinese and other restricted parties remotely accessing computing power in third-country data centers. This article will describe the current lay of the land under the Export Administration Regulations ("EAR") as administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security ("BIS"), cover the most recent notable developments, and provide tips for companies. Current controls in place Despite certain twists and turns discussed below, the controls in place largely resemble those imposed by the Biden Administration in October 2023. Specifically, advanced semiconductors and computing items that incorporate them (e.g., servers) are controlled for export, reexport, and transfer (in country) to (a) BIS Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including China and certain countries in the Middle East, among others) and (b) end users that are headquartered in, or have an ultimate parent headquartered in, a country in Country Group D:5 (including China). The controlled items consist of: •integrated circuits ("ICs") with a "total processing performance" ("TPP") of 1,600 or more and a "performance density" of 3.2 or more, and computers incorporating such ICs (with the strictest controls for ICs with (a) TPP of 4,800 or more, or (b) TPP of 1,600 or more and "performance density" of 5.92 or more); and •high bandwidth memory having a "memory bandwidth density" greater than two gigabytes per second per square millimeter. If an item is subject to a BIS licensing requirement, then depending on the destination and the end user, a transaction can be subject to a licensing presumption of approval or denial, or case-by-case consideration. Transactions with Country Group D:5 companies or D:5-headquartered companies generally are subject to a presumption of denial. There are also EAR license exceptions available, including License Exceptions Notified Advanced Computing ("NAC") and Advanced Computing Authorized ("ACA"). These permit certain license-free transactions involving less-sensitive controlled items, as well as sensitive items that are not designed or marketed for use in a data center, either with prior notice to BIS (under NAC, for transactions involving D:5 recipients or D:5-headquartered recipients) or without notice (under ACA, for non-D:5 transactions). Regarding NAC, however, in practice it is not clear whether BIS actually is processing NAC notifications. Finally, it should be noted that the EAR also set out significant controls relating to exports, reexports, and transfers (in country) of semiconductor manufacturing equipment or otherwise in support of integrated circuit or supercomputer development or production in China and other D:5 countries, along with U.S. person support for such activities, although these measures are beyond the scope of this article. Whither the AI Diffusion Rule? Any company seeking to operate in this landscape must take into account the "AI Diffusion Rule" and its current status under the EAR as administered by the Trump Administration. Specifically, in January 2025, in the final days of the Biden Administration, BIS issued the AI Diffusion Rule, which overhauled the above controls to impose a worldwide export licensing requirement for the relevant controlled items, as compared to controls limited to Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5. With this worldwide control in place, the rule then provided for the "diffusion" of controlled items through various newly issued license exceptions, countrywide computing power quotas, and licensing policies. The rule also imposed controls over certain AI model weights. The rule, which was scheduled to go into effect in May 2025, drew criticism that it was overly complex and burdensome, and various foreign governments complained that their assigned computing quotas were too low. The Trump Administration, in response to this sentiment, announced in May 2025 that it would not enforce the rule, and eventually would rescind it. As of this time, the rescission still has not taken place, although in May 2026 the Administration reiterated its position that it would not enforce the rule and clarified that licensing requirements remain in effect for Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5, as well as D:5-headquartered companies. Overall, for companies seeking to comply with the EAR as currently enforced, it is vital to review BIS's May 2025 and May 2026 pronouncements on the AI Diffusion Rule, and to consider how to comply with the version of the EAR that the Trump Administration currently is enforcing regarding advanced computing items. Notably, the AI Diffusion Rule remains in the Code of Federal Regulations throughout various provisions of the EAR, and a newcomer might conclude that these are the actual rules to follow. Companies should consider consulting counsel and/or using publicly available tools to run comparison versions of the EAR or view the text as in effect at an earlier date. Changes in treatment for China China remains subject to strict controls under the advanced computing provisions of the EAR, although there have been targeted areas of relief. First, as discussed in a March 2026 Reuters article , BIS amended the EAR to allow for case-by-case consideration of exports to China of advanced computing items under certain circumstances. Specifically, this policy can apply where the exporter certifies the commercial availability of the item, the sufficiency of its U.S. domestic supply, and certain security assurances. The policy is available only for items with a TPP of less than 21,000 and a "total DRAM bandwidth" of less than 6,500 GB/s. Second, the Trump Administration has indicated openness to licensing exports to China of H200 chips, which are less sensitive AI chips. Despite this policy, however, reports indicate that not many such licensed exports have taken place, as the Chinese government reportedly has discouraged companies from buying the chips. Change in status for United Arab Emirates In July 2026, BIS moved the United Arab Emirates out of Country Groups D:3 and D:4 and into Country Group A:5, making it the first Arab country to enter the favorable A:5 group. This had the effect of removing export licensing requirements for advanced computing items, although it is important to note that this favorable treatment is available only for the UAE government and for certain companies specifically identified in the EAR. Remote computing challenges Perhaps the most notable policy challenge and hottest-button issue for companies in this area is the question of restricted parties remotely accessing advanced computing items to train AI models without actually physically receiving the chips. For example, under this approach, a Chinese company can sign up as an infrastructure as a service ("IaaS") customer for a data center in Malaysia, which is not a restricted destination for controlled chips. In this hypothetical, the Chinese company can then train an AI model by remotely accessing the chips that it would not be permitted to receive in China without a BIS license. BIS has not provided definitive guidance on this subject, except to issue a notice in May 2025 stating that there could be a licensing requirement to the extent that an exporter, reexport, or in-country transferor has knowledge that a Country Group D:5 party is remotely accessing computing power to train AI models for military-intelligence end uses or end users. Notably, the application of this concept to "transferors" likely would extend to IaaS providers and data center operators that have knowledge of such military-intelligence applications. Notably, Congress is seeking to address this issue in the Remote Access Security Act, which would give BIS authority to regulate remote access to items that are subject to the EAR. The bill passed the full House of Representatives in January 2026, although its prospects for passage by the U.S. Senate and signature by President Trump are unclear. Compliance tips for companies Companies looking to set up or supply AI data centers should develop a compliance plan to address the most persistent challenges in this area, including: •Understanding and operationalizing compliance around the advanced computing rules that are currently in effect; •Conducting robust due diligence on counterparties and end users to seek to ensure that they are not headquartered in a Country Group D:5 country or ultimately owned by a D:5-based parent, including, as warranted, deep vendor-based diligence to try and penetrate opaque ownership structures; •Securing assurances regarding the non-use of controlled items in training AI models for military-intelligence end uses or end users; and •Planning for the possibility that BIS eventually will be empowered to regulate remote access to controlled items.

item.title: Bericht: Überprüfungsgespräch bei Volkswagen am 30. September
item.description: Im Ringen um Einsparungen bei Volkswagen treffen sich die IG Metall und das Management nach Informationen aus Verhandlungskreisen kommende Woche zu einem ersten Gespräch. Beide Seiten kämen am 30. September in Hannover zusammen, hieß es am Mittwoch aus Verhandlungskreisen. Zuvor hatte das "Handelsblatt" über den Termin berichtet. Im Mittelpunkt stünden die Zusagen für die Werke Emden, Zwickau und Hannover, hieß es in dem Bericht.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Im Ringen um Einsparungen bei Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) treffen sich die IG Metall und das Management nach Informationen aus Verhandlungskreisen kommende Woche zu einem ersten Gespräch. Beide Seiten kämen am 30. September in Hannover zusammen, hieß es am Mittwoch aus Verhandlungskreisen. Zuvor hatte das "Handelsblatt" über den Termin berichtet. Im Mittelpunkt stünden die Zusagen für die Werke Emden, Zwickau und Hannover, hieß es in dem Bericht. Die IG Metall und der Betriebsrat hatten Mitte September die Revisionsklausel aus dem Tarifvertrag vom Dezember 2024 gezogen. Diese sieht Gespräche mit dem Management vor, wenn sich die Rahmenbedingungen änderten. Kommt es bei den Verhandlungen zu keiner Einigung, kann nach Gewerkschaftsangaben die Schlichtungsstelle angerufen werden. Im Dezember 2024 hatten sich Arbeitnehmer und Vorstand nach monatelangem Ringen auf einen Tarifvertrag geeinigt. Dabei verständigten sich beide Seiten auf den Abbau von 35.000 Arbeitsplätzen. Im Gegenzug sagte der Vorstand unter anderem eine Beschäftigungsgarantie bis Ende 2030 und Modelle für die Standorte Emden, Zwickau und Hannover zu. VW-Chef Oliver Blume hat zuletzt seinen Sparkurs nochmal verschärft. Er will die Rendite bis 2030 auf neun Prozent steigern. Dazu sollen rund 50.000 Stellen weltweit wegfallen. Vier deutsche Werke stehen auf dem Prüfstand.

item.title: BCE tendrá que volver a intervenir si se producen efectos de segunda ronda en la inflación: Makhlouf
item.description: El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que volver a subir las tasas de interés si los elevados precios de la energía se trasladan a otros sectores, aunque por el momento no hay indicios de que se estén produciendo esos efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, dijo el miércoles Gabriel Makhlouf, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que volver a subir las tasas de interés si los elevados precios de la energía se trasladan a otros sectores, aunque por el momento no hay indicios de que se estén produciendo esos efectos de segunda ronda sobre la inflación, dijo el miércoles Gabriel Makhlouf, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE. "Aunque la inflación está por encima de nuestro objetivo, no estamos observando ese tipo de efectos de segunda ronda que empiecen a repercutir en los precios", declaró Makhlouf, presidente del Banco Central de Irlanda, en una entrevista concedida a la cadena nacional RTE. "Si eso ocurre (que los precios de la energía se mantengan altos y se trasladen a otros sectores), tendremos que volver a tomar medidas para cumplir nuestro objetivo", señaló. Makhlouf ya había advertido a principios de este mes, tras la segunda subida de las tasas del BCE este año, que elevarlas "mucho más" corre el riesgo de perjudicar el crecimiento económico.

item.title: Dutch look to Xavi to restore traditional football ethos
item.description: Dutch footballing philosophy has had a marked impact on the all-conquering success of Spain recently, but now that the Netherlands are looking to bolster their own fortunes they have turned to a Spanish World Cup winner for inspiration.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dutch footballing philosophy has had a marked impact on the all-conquering success of Spain recently, but now that the Netherlands are looking to bolster their own fortunes they have turned to a Spanish World Cup winner for inspiration. Former Barcelona midfielder and coach Xavi Hernandez has become the first foreigner in charge of the Dutch national team since the 1978 World Cup. Xavi, who as a player won the World Cup in 2010 and two European Championships, debuts as coach on Thursday when the Dutch host Germany in Amsterdam and will have three more Nations League matches in the three-week international window. The Netherlands have turned to him for a change in perspective after spells under Ronald Koeman and Louis van Gaal sparked much disquiet over the team’s tactics and playing philosophy. Both coaches were accused of abandoning traditional Dutch values around ball possession and attacking football and employing counter-attacks as their primary weapon. Although Van Gaal took the team to the 2022 World Cup quarter-finals and Koeman the semis of Euro 2024, elimination in the round of 32 at this year’s World Cup was a major disappointment. "It is about how we in the Netherlands want to play football," said former international Nigel de Jong, who, as technical director at the Dutch football association, recruited Xavi. "That means playing dominantly and being attractive in a good way while doing so. Dominant does not always mean playing attacking football; we also want to be dominant defensively. By conceding fewer goals, we want to try to win matches." Although the 46-year-old Xavi is a relatively inexperienced coach, the Dutch feel that as a player, he had much of what their side misses, in terms of technique, discipline and creativity. BARCELONA INFLUENCE He also showed during his coaching tenure at Barcelona, where he won La Liga in his first season in charge, the ideas the Dutch supporters want to see from their team. "After the first meeting, I immediately felt like going out onto the pitch. New ideas and a new way of playing football. I think it is also good for the group," said midfielder Tijjani Reijnders. Xavi, who has a four-year contract, told a press conference on Wednesday he felt the players had bought into his game model and philosophy, which he has described as revolving around possession, position, pressing, perception, and passion. “You need possession to win the match," he said. "You need the right positions. When you lose the ball, you have to press. And you need perception to see what is happening around you and understand the game. But without passion, you cannot play football.” But he was also clear that winning remains the end goal. “I think there is definitely potential in this squad,” Xavi said.

item.title: India's $507 million line of credit to Maldives effective August 27, cenbank says
item.description: India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India government-backed 48.50 billion rupees ($506.58 million) line of credit to the Maldives became effective on August 27, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday, paving the way for individual project-level credit agreements under the facility. Here are some details: The RBI said that the facility will be deployed through individual credit agreements with minimum value of 5 billion rupees each Under the agreement, at least 75% of the value of goods, works and services under contracts financed through the facility must be supplied by sellers from India, while the remaining 25% may be sourced from outside India. The regulator said the line of credit cannot be used to pay agency commissions on exports, adding that exporters can use their own funds for such payments. India had agreed to provide line of credit to the Maldives in July 2025 via the Export-Import Bank to finance various developmental projects in the country. ($1 = 95.7400 Indian rupees)

item.title: BCE terá que agir novamente se surgirem efeitos de segunda ordem sobre a inflação, diz Makhlouf
item.description: O Banco Central Europeu terá que aumentar as taxas de juros novamente se os preços elevados da energia se refletirem em outros setores, mas até o momento não há sinais desses efeitos de inflação de segunda ordem, afirmou nesta quarta-feira Gabriel Makhlouf, membro do BCE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco Central Europeu terá que aumentar as taxas de juros novamente se os preços elevados da energia se refletirem em outros setores, mas até o momento não há sinais desses efeitos de inflação de segunda ordem, afirmou nesta quarta-feira Gabriel Makhlouf, membro do BCE. “Embora a inflação esteja acima da nossa meta, não estamos vendo o tipo de efeito de segunda ordem que começa a se refletir nos preços”, disse Makhlouf, presidente do banco central da Irlanda, em entrevista à emissora nacional RTE. “Se isso acontecer (os preços da energia permanecerem altos e se refletirem em outros setores), teremos que tomar medidas novamente para atingir nossa meta.” Makhlouf alertou neste mês, após o segundo aumento da taxa de juros pelo BCE neste ano, que elevar as taxas de juros “muito mais” corre o risco de prejudicar o crescimento econômico. (Reportagem de Padraic Halpin)

item.title: ZEW-Präsident und ADAC warnen vor Nebenwirkungen von Spritpreisdeckel
item.description: Der von der Bundesregierung geplante Spritpreisdeckel stößt zunehmend auf Kritik. Der Ökonom und Wettbewerbsexperte Achim Wambach warnte am Mittwoch vor zu starken Nebenwirkungen. "Die Erfahrungen mit der 12-Uhr-Regel mahnen zur Vorsicht", teilte der Präsident des Mannheimer Forschungsinstituts ZEW mit. Ohne überzeugende Belege, dass er wirke, sollte der Preisdeckel nicht eingeführt werden. Der ADAC forderte zudem die Abschaffung der Regel, dass nur ein Mal am Tag um 12 Uhr die Tankstellenpreise erhöht werden dürfen. Dies habe nicht den gewünschten Effekt erzielt. Ein Preisdeckel könnte auch den Wettbewerb einschränken und am Ende nicht zu niedrigeren Preisen führen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der von der Bundesregierung geplante Spritpreisdeckel stößt zunehmend auf Kritik. Der Ökonom und Wettbewerbsexperte Achim Wambach warnte am Mittwoch vor zu starken Nebenwirkungen. "Die Erfahrungen mit der 12-Uhr-Regel mahnen zur Vorsicht", teilte der Präsident des Mannheimer Forschungsinstituts ZEW mit. Ohne überzeugende Belege, dass er wirke, sollte der Preisdeckel nicht eingeführt werden. Der ADAC forderte zudem die Abschaffung der Regel, dass nur ein Mal am Tag um 12 Uhr die Tankstellenpreise erhöht werden dürfen. Dies habe nicht den gewünschten Effekt erzielt. Ein Preisdeckel könnte auch den Wettbewerb einschränken und am Ende nicht zu niedrigeren Preisen führen. Die schwarz-rote Koalition hatte sich am vergangenen Freitag wegen der zuletzt wieder stark gestiegenen Tankstellenpreise im Zuge des Nahost-Krieges auf ein [USN:L8N45A1LZ TEXT:"Entlastungspaket"] verständigt. Es sieht einen Tankrabatt von 17 Cent je Liter Benzin und Diesel in den Monaten Oktober bis Dezember vor. Zudem soll das bei dem Thema eigentlich skeptische Wirtschaftsministerium einen Gesetzentwurf für einen Preisdeckel nach dem Vorbild Luxemburgs oder Belgiens ausarbeiten, der dann ab spätestens Anfang 2027 greifen soll. Wambach schrieb in einem Meinungsbeitrag, wenn die Rendite auf dem Markt staatlich begrenzt werde, würden Raffinerien andere Produkte herstellen, Lieferungen in andere Märkte umlenken und auch anderswo investieren. "Der Staat muss nun beurteilen, welche Beschaffungskosten angemessen sind, welche Transport- und Lagerkosten berücksichtigt werden und welche Marge den Unternehmen verbleiben soll." Preise sollten aber keine "politische Verschiebungsmasse" sein. Eine ZEW-Untersuchung zur 12-Uhr-Regel habe gezeigt, dass die Margen bei Benzin nach der Einführung kurzfristig um etwa fünf bis sechs Cent je Liter gestiegen seien. TANKRABATT SOLL SCHON FREITAG BESCHLOSSEN WERDEN Die Regierung wollte mit der Maßnahme im Frühjahr häufige Preisveränderungen unterbinden und für mehr Transparenz sorgen. Der ADAC forderte, die Regel abzuschaffen. Sie habe die Preise keinesfalls gesenkt. Die Preisdifferenz innerhalb eines Tages sei nun noch größer. "Wer mittags nach zwölf Uhr tanken muss, hat erhebliche Zusatzkosten", so ADAC-Verkehrspräsident Peter König. Er begrüßte den Tankrabatt, der schnell wirke. "Wer täglich auf das Auto angewiesen ist, braucht jetzt Entlastung - und kann nicht darauf warten, dass irgendwann bessere Instrumente entwickelt werden." Beim Preisdeckel bestehe das Risiko, dass der festzulegende Höchstpreis zur Orientierung für alle Anbieter werde und der Wettbewerb nachlasse, so der ADAC. Der Deckel dürfe aber nicht zu einer Verknappung des Angebots und im Extremfall zu Einschränkungen der Versorgung führen. Außerdem gebe es starke regionale Unterschiede in Deutschland - anders als in kleineren Staaten. "Ein einheitlicher Höchstpreis ist deshalb besonders anspruchsvoll." Der Tankrabatt soll am Freitag im Bundestag und Bundesrat beschlossen werden. Die über eine Mehrheit verfügenden Bundestagsfraktionen von Union und SPD begrüßten die Neuauflage am Mittwoch im Ausschuss für Wirtschaft und Energie. Im Mai und Juni gab es bereits einen Tankrabatt, der laut Kartellamt aber nur zu etwa 80 Prozent bei den Verbrauchern ankam.

item.title: With win over Royals, White Sox would edge closer to crowning achievement
item.description: After three straight 100-loss seasons, the Chicago White Sox can clinch a spot in the American League playoffs on Wednesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After three straight 100-loss seasons, the Chicago White Sox can clinch a spot in the American League playoffs on Wednesday night. The White Sox (81-76) carry a magic number of two to earn a playoff berth as they try for a series victory against the host Kansas City Royals (67-90). "Every night here on out, it's playoff atmosphere baseball," White Sox outfielder Randal Grichuk said. Grichuk went 4-for-5 with a three-run home run and finished a triple shy of the cycle as Chicago outslugged Kansas City 14-11 in Tuesday's series opener. Chase Meidroth went deep as part of a 3-for-4, five-RBI showing, and Brenton Doyle and Munetaka Murakami also homered. The White Sox improved to 9-0 this season when they hit at least four home runs. Chicago remained one game behind the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians while staying three games clear of the White Sox's nearest competitor -- the Texas Rangers -- for the third and final AL wild-card spot. A White Sox win, plus a Rangers loss to the New York Mets on Wednesday, would clinch at least a wild-card spot for Chicago. White Sox starter Anthony Kay worked just four-plus innings on Tuesday, but the offense picked up the slack with 13 hits. Grichuk paced the attack. He is batting .373 with five doubles, a triple, three home runs and 11 RBIs in September. "I feel good. Mechanically, I feel good. Mentally, I'm in a good spot," Grichuk said. "Hopefully, it can continue. This is when you want to be at your best, obviously. Playing meaningful games in September trying to get to October." Kansas City has lost five straight games and eight of nine but is coming off its best offensive output in nearly a month. Tuesday marked the first time the Royals scored double-digit runs since a 13-2 victory at Toronto on Aug. 27. Vinnie Pasquantino belted a ninth-inning grand slam to punctuate a 3-for-5, five-RBI night. Bobby Witt Jr. added three hits and Jac Caglianone had two. Kansas City on Wednesday will turn to right-hander Seth Lugo (7-9, 5.06 ERA), an 11-year veteran who is aiming to avoid his first career season with double-digit losses. Lugo has worked five innings in each of his first three September starts. He took the 6-2 loss at Houston on Thursday, giving up four runs and eight hits with one walk and five strikeouts. The Astros hit four solo home runs against Lugo, who has surrendered multiple long balls in a game six times this season. "It sounds kind of strange, but I think his stuff was pretty crisp," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said after that game. "He just missed on a couple, and they got him on first pitches." Lugo pitched effectively against the host White Sox on April 9 but lost 2-0 after allowing two runs (one earned) and four hits in 6 1/3 innings. He also was the losing pitcher in a 6-5 game in Chicago on May 13, giving up five runs on eight hits and two walks in five innings. In eight career starts against the White Sox, including seven starts, Lugo is 3-2 with a 2.14 ERA over 46 1/3 innings. Left-hander Bryan Hudson (5-4, 3.03 ERA) will serve as the opener for Chicago on Wednesday ahead of right-hander Erick Fedde (8-9, 3.90), who has worked 10 innings over two starts against the Royals this season, going 0-1 with a 2.70 ERA. The loss came on April 11, 2-0. Fedde is 1-2 with a 2.84 ERA in five career starts vs. Kansas City covering 25 1/3 innings. He took a no-decision against the visiting Detroit Tigers on Thursday, permitting one run and four hits in 4 2/3 innings with two walks and six strikeouts in a 3-1 win. --Field Level Media

item.title: Geely turns to 4-minute EV charging, AI in battle with BYD
item.description: China's Geely responded to the challenge posed by rival BYD on Wednesday with a system that can charge an EV in just four minutes, the industry's fastest speed.
item.dc:creator: Ju-min Park
item.content:encoded: China's Geely (0175.HK) responded to the challenge posed by rival BYD (002594.SZ) on Wednesday with a system that can charge an EV in just four minutes, the industry's fastest speed. Geely also introduced a next-generation electric vehicle battery and an upgraded Galaxy E5 pure-electric SUV as it seeks to revive sales in China, where EV sales [USN:L1N450052 TEXT:"declined"] for 11 consecutive months through August. China's EV market has moved into a battle over technology, with automakers competing on intelligent driving systems, range and ultra-fast charging capabilities to attract buyers. Supported by a 2.2-megawatt charging infrastructure and a high-rate battery capacity, Geely said its new setup can charge a vehicle from 10% to 70% in 4.5 minutes, and from 10% to 97% in 8 minutes and 40 seconds under normal ambient temperatures. "Current charging speeds are already approaching the physical limit, and the marginal gains from pursuing even faster speeds in the future will become increasingly small," Geely executive Zhang Dewang told Reuters at the launch event. To ensure stability and safety under such high power, Geely is deploying AI across cloud and on-vehicle systems. It uses cloud-based twin simulations paired with deep-learning models deployed directly on the EV to monitor battery health, manage thermal control, and predict potential hazards. The new technology is Geely's direct response to aggressive moves by rivals such as BYD, which have invested heavily in flash-charging and megawatt-level charging networks to ease range anxiety and win customers. Earlier this year, BYD [USN:L1N3ZT0L3 TEXT:"unveiled"] a new generation [USN:L1N45008T TEXT:"flash-charging"] system that can charge a battery from 10% to 97% in nine minutes. It plans to build 90,000 stations by 2028, Deutsche Bank has said, citing a meeting with BYD's management. Geely's Zhang said the broader charging ecosystem would in the future resemble traditional gasoline stations with diverse brands, adding that multi-party infrastructure development will accelerate the global rollout of fast-charging networks.

item.title: Precios del mercado mundial del gas estiman escasez prolongada por guerra en Irán, dice ejecutivo de IGU
item.description: Los mercados mundiales del gas están descontando cada vez más una escasez de suministro que se prolongará mucho más allá del invierno boreal, ya que la guerra en Irán está perturbando las exportaciones de gas natural licuado (GNL) del golfo Pérsico y complica los esfuerzos de Europa por reponer sus reservas de gas, dijo un ejecutivo de alto rango del sector.
item.dc:creator: Marwa Rashad
item.content:encoded: Los mercados mundiales del gas están descontando cada vez más una escasez de suministro que se prolongará mucho más allá del invierno boreal, ya que la guerra en Irán está perturbando las exportaciones de gas natural licuado (GNL) del golfo Pérsico y complica los esfuerzos de Europa por reponer sus reservas de gas, dijo un ejecutivo de alto rango del sector. Esta perspectiva surge en un momento en que Europa compite con Asia por los cargamentos de GNL mientras intenta reponer las reservas antes del invierno en el hemisferio norte, en medio de la continua incertidumbre sobre el impacto del conflicto en las exportaciones de Qatar, uno de los mayores proveedores de GNL del mundo. Los precios a futuro del gas sugieren que los operadores esperan que los valores elevados y los riesgos de suministro persistan hasta el próximo verano boreal antes de que disminuyan, según Menelaos Ydreos, secretario general de la Unión Internacional del Gas (IGU, por su sigla en inglés), cuyos miembros representan más del 90% del mercado mundial del gas. "En estos momentos, el mercado está indicando que prevé que el conflicto se prolongue", dijo Ydreos a Reuters. Las curvas de futuros actuales indican que los mercados esperan que la escasez continúe hasta el año que viene, lo que supone un cambio notable respecto a hace unos meses, cuando los operadores esperaban que los precios bajasen tras el invierno, señaló. "Europa está empezando a superar a Asia en las pujas porque necesita reponer sus niveles de almacenamiento", señaló Ydreos, añadiendo que la crisis actual difiere de la crisis energética que siguió a la invasión de Ucrania por parte de Rusia en 2022, ya que está afectando a varias regiones al mismo tiempo. "Se está produciendo una cierta destrucción de la demanda a corto plazo. La cuestión es si se recuperará una vez que todo se calme o si habrá implicaciones a más largo plazo en torno a las políticas", señaló Ydreos. La incertidumbre se ve agravada por la prohibición prevista por Europa de importar GNL ruso a partir de enero. Es probable que los cargamentos rusos que se dirigen actualmente a Europa encuentren compradores alternativos, posiblemente a precios más bajos. Pero cualquier interrupción de esos flujos añadiría más presión a un mercado que ya se enfrenta a preocupaciones sobre el suministro de Oriente Medio, señaló Ydreos. Los funcionarios europeos también se debaten sobre cómo equilibrar los objetivos climáticos con la seguridad energética y la asequibilidad, señaló, y añadió que la Comisión Europea debería plantearse flexibilizar algunos requisitos de aplicación, manteniendo intactos los objetivos de reducción de emisiones. "Estamos a favor de la normativa, pero debe ser alcanzable, práctica e incentivar el cumplimiento", afirmó. "Si la normativa va mucho más allá de eso y hace que al sector le sea extremadamente difícil cumplirla, buscarán otras regiones a las que enviar su producto".

item.title: Ryanair CEO O'Leary says airline will not levy fuel surcharge
item.description: Ryanair group CEO Michael O'Leary said on Wednesday the airline "will not levy a fuel surcharge" amid higher prices for jet oil, though he predicted rivals may do so, and forecast more consolidation in the sector as a result of elevated fuel costs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ryanair (RYA.I) group CEO Michael O'Leary said on Wednesday the airline "will not levy a fuel surcharge" amid higher prices for jet oil, though he predicted rivals may do so, and forecast more consolidation in the sector as a result of elevated fuel costs. He told reporters: "Most of the airlines were well hedged into the summer of 2026, and therefore we absorb the kind of shock of the much higher oil prices this summer. "None of us will be able to absorb those much higher oil prices next year ... and it will get passed on in the form of fuel surcharges on higher airfares. "Ryanair will not levy a fuel surcharge, but the legacy guys certainly will next summer." O'Leary added: "I very much hope that jet (fuel) prices will rise faster into next year because that will accelerate the extent to which other airlines will fail. "Airlines who are currently loss-making will fail. It will accelerate the consolidation of Europe into four large airlines: BA (British Airways), Lufthansa, Air France and Ryanair."

item.title: Ejército polaco dice que helicóptero militar ruso entró brevemente en espacio aéreo de Polonia
item.description: Un helicóptero militar ruso Mi-8 realizó una breve incursión en el espacio aéreo de Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, desde el enclave ruso de Kaliningrado, según informó este miércoles el Mando Operativo del Ejército polaco.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un helicóptero militar ruso Mi-8 realizó una breve incursión en el espacio aéreo de Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, desde el enclave ruso de Kaliningrado, según informó este miércoles el Mando Operativo del Ejército polaco. El helicóptero permaneció 42 segundos en el espacio aéreo polaco y se adentró hasta una profundidad máxima de unos 300 metros, según se indicó en la red social X. "Se despegaron aviones de combate y las fuerzas y medios terrestres permanecieron en estado de alerta. La naturaleza del incidente indica que Rusia está poniendo a prueba, una vez más, la preparación de nuestra defensa aérea", afirmó. Polonia se encuentra en estado de alerta máxima ante cualquier incursión en su espacio aéreo relacionada con la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania. La embajada rusa en Varsovia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters sobre el incidente.

item.title: Victims of alleged abuse by Slovenian priest urge Pope Leo to expedite Church trial
item.description: Five victims of alleged abuse by a prominent priest with Vatican ties urged Pope Leo on Wednesday to press for the conclusion of a nearly year-long Church trial of the cleric, saying a lengthy and secret process was denying them justice.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Five victims of alleged abuse by a prominent priest with Vatican ties urged Pope Leo on Wednesday to press for the conclusion of a nearly year-long Church trial of the cleric, saying a lengthy and secret process was denying them justice. In an open letter ahead of Leo's [USN:L8N45A0L5 TEXT:"four-day visit to France"], where the pope is hoping to repair the Church's standing [USN:L1N45B02J TEXT:"after abuse scandals"] there, victims of [USN:L8N4510TH TEXT:"Rev. Marko Rupnik"] said their treatment reflects poorly on the Church's commitment to helping victims. "This is the message being conveyed ... that it is useless to report abuse to ecclesiastical authorities, because nothing happens anyway and no one will be held accountable," read the letter. The victims said they had received no updates about the Church trial and had not been able to offer testimony. They urged Leo to press for a fair trial "so that the judgment and its outcome, whatever it may be, will remain free of any shadow of doubt." The Vatican press office did not immediately offer comment. Rupnik, a Slovenian priest, is a religious artist whose mosaics adorn about 200 churches and chapels around the world, including a basilica in Lourdes, France, where the pope will visit on Saturday. The bishop of Lourdes has ordered that the mosaics be covered up for the pope's visit. More than 20 women, mostly former nuns, have accused Rupnik of sexual and psychological abuse. The priest, expelled from the Jesuit order in 2023 after it found the accusations against him to be "very highly" credible, is not known to have commented publicly on the allegations. The head of the Vatican's powerful doctrinal office first announced a Church trial against Rupnik in October 2025. Such trials are held behind closed doors and there have been few updates since. In July, the Vatican [USN:L8N4510TH TEXT:"denied reports"] that a decision had been made in the case.

item.title: Juventus keeper Grabara undergoes knee surgery after ACL tear
item.description: Juventus keeper Kamil Grabara has undergone knee surgery after tearing his anterior cruciate ligament during training, the 27-year-old announced on social media on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Juventus keeper Kamil Grabara has undergone knee surgery after tearing his anterior cruciate ligament during training, the 27-year-old announced on social media on Wednesday. Grabara is set to miss Poland's Nations League group stage matches against Bosnia and Herzegovina, with media reports saying the keeper faces up to seven months on the sidelines. "I’m not going to lie, this is not something I ever wanted to post, but life comes at you fast sometimes," Grabara wrote on Instagram, posting a picture of himself on a hospital bed. After joining Juventus on loan from Wolfsburg in August, Grabara debuted for the Serie A side on Thursday, providing an assist and winning the player-of-the-match award in a [USN:L6N45917E TEXT:"5-0 Europa League win"] over NEC Nijmegen. On Saturday, however, he felt a strain in his right knee during training, and tests revealed he had suffered an ACL tear. Local media reported that Juventus were nearing a deal with 37-year-old Brazilian Neto, who played for the club from 2015 to 2017, as Grabara's replacement.

item.title: Alonso pide cambios tras el "asesinato" de los circuitos de F1
item.description: El piloto español Fernando Alonso pidió el miércoles a la Fórmula 1 que haga que las carreras sean más divertidas el año que viene, afirmando que muchos de los circuitos actuales han perdido su carácter tradicional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El piloto español Fernando Alonso pidió el miércoles a la Fórmula 1 que haga que las carreras sean más divertidas el año que viene, afirmando que muchos de los circuitos actuales han perdido su carácter tradicional. El Gran Premio de Azerbaiyán comienza el viernes con la primera sesión de entrenamientos. La última carrera se celebró en Madrid por primera vez, pero el circuito fue objeto de críticas por parte de varios pilotos, entre ellos el campeón del mundo Lando Norris. Otros calificaron la carrera de "desfile". Alonso no solo se mostró crítico con el circuito MadRing en unas declaraciones a Motorsport.com, sino que afirmó que varios circuitos no propiciaban carreras emocionantes. "Silverstone, un circuito increíble, ya no es divertido", afirmó Alonso. "En Spa fue casi vergonzoso pasar por Eau Rouge; en Suzuka, la 130R… Hay circuitos que han sido asesinados este año", afirmó. El piloto de Aston Martin se mostró optimista respecto a la popularidad actual de la Fórmula 1, pero también se pronunció a favor de introducir más cambios en la potencia del motor. La Fórmula 1 ha anunciado cambios para 2027 en lo que respecta al equilibrio de potencia entre el componente eléctrico y el de combustión. Alonso reduciría la aceleración inmediata que proporciona el componente eléctrico a cambio de mantener la velocidad durante más tiempo. Es un tema, según afirma, que comenta habitualmente con el director ejecutivo de la Fórmula 1, Stefano Domenicali, y con Mohammed Ben Sulayem, presidente de la Federación Internacional del Automóvil. "Quizá desde la cabina, al volante, sobre todo si estás en otras categorías o has probado otros monoplazas de Fórmula 1, se siente cierta frustración", afirmó Alonso.

item.title: Russian military helicopter entered Polish airspace briefly, Polish army says
item.description: A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter made a brief incursion into NATO member Poland's airspace from the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, the Polish Army Operational Command said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter made a brief incursion into NATO member Poland's airspace from the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, the Polish Army Operational Command said on Wednesday. The helicopter spent 42 seconds in Polish airspace and entered to a maximum depth of about 300 metres (328 yards), it said on X. "Fighter aircraft were scrambled, and ground-based forces and assets remained on standby. The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense," it said. Poland is on heightened alert for any incursion into its airspace connected with Russia's war in Ukraine . The Russian embassy in Warsaw did not immediately reply to a Reuters request for comment on the incident.

item.title: Greece proposes European Spectrum Union to raise billions for EU budget from 6G mobile
item.description: Greece has proposed that European Union states should create a European Spectrum Union which could use some of the funds raised by future national sales of 6G mobile spectrum for technology investment, easing pressure on the bloc's budget.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Greece has proposed that European Union states should create a European Spectrum Union which could use some of the funds raised by future national sales of 6G mobile spectrum for technology investment, easing pressure on the bloc's budget. "The potential initial financial scale could be around €12–15 billion," according to the proposal, developed by the chairman of euro zone finance ministers Kyriakos Pierrakakis and presented to EU ministers on Tuesday. "At this stage, this is a planning assumption rather than an official valuation or forecast, and does not include any potential future contribution from selected 5G rights," it said. If the idea is accepted by the 27 countries making up the EU, the money could help ease the problem of how to finance the EU's 2028-2034 budget, proposed at €2 trillion - the main source of financing for all of the EU's main policies. Negotiations on the financing are tough, because the budget will have to deal with new challenges like more spending on defence and making Europe more competitive, while retaining most of the spending on old policies to support farming and cohesion. Among other new financing options, rejected by some countries and supported by others, is using a share of the cash that EU governments get from selling CO2 emissions permits to companies and a share of the tax on goods imported into the EU that were made in countries where climate policies are weaker than in the EU. Other options include a tax on non-collected e-waste, a share of the tobacco excise duty and an annual lump-sum contribution from large firms operating and selling in the EU. Further proposals include a levy on extreme wealth, on digital services, online gambling and crypto asset capital gains. Ireland will now have to see which of these options, or a mix of them, has a chance to get unanimous support from all 27 EU countries by the next EU summit scheduled for October.

item.title: Los líderes de Tigré anuncian una nueva guerra contra el Gobierno etíope
item.description: Los líderes de la región de Tigré, en el norte de Etiopía, afirmaron el miércoles que habían entrado en una nueva guerra con el Gobierno federal, al estallar los combates en Tigré y en dos regiones vecinas, lo que ha roto un acuerdo de paz que llevaba cuatro años en vigor.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los líderes de la región de Tigré, en el norte de Etiopía, afirmaron el miércoles que habían entrado en una nueva guerra con el Gobierno federal, al estallar los combates en Tigré y en dos regiones vecinas, lo que ha roto un acuerdo de paz que llevaba cuatro años en vigor. La guerra civil de 2020-2022 entre el Frente Popular de Liberación de Tigré (TPLF, por sus siglas en inglés) y las fuerzas federales se saldó con cientos de miles de muertos antes de que se firmara el Acuerdo de Pretoria en noviembre de 2022. El estallido de nuevos combates se produce tras meses de creciente animosidad entre ambas partes, que culminó con el anuncio del domingo de que el TPLF había formado una alianza con otros seis grupos armados de toda Etiopía con el objetivo de derrocar al Gobierno del primer ministro Abiy Ahmed. "Tras la intensificación de la invasión llevada a cabo mediante diversos métodos por el régimen autocrático y genocida de la Prosperidad de Abiy Ahmed contra el pueblo de Tigré (...), el Gobierno Regional Nacional de Tigré anunció que se ha ordenado a las Fuerzas de Tigré que contrarresten el ataque y que han entrado en una guerra defensiva", dijo el Gobierno regional liderado por el TPLF en un comunicado. Getachew Reda, asesor de Abiy y antiguo dirigente del TPLF, escribió en la red social X que el TPLF había tomado el control de los aeropuertos de Tigré, gestionados por el Gobierno federal, y había lanzado una "ofensiva a gran escala" contra las posiciones gubernamentales en las regiones vecinas de Afar y Amhara. Ethiopian Airlines suspendió los vuelos a la región. GRUPOS ARMADOS SE ALIAN CON LOS TIGRANIOS Cuatro fuentes —entre ellas un alto cargo del Gobierno etíope, una fuente diplomática, una fuente humanitaria y otra fuente vinculada al TPLF y a una milicia aliada— confirmaron los acontecimientos en Tigré, Afar y Amhara. Afirmaron que, en Afar, las fuerzas tigranias luchaban junto a un grupo armado local, y que, en Amhara, luchaban junto a la milicia Fano. Fano se alineó con el Gobierno federal durante la guerra de 2020-2022, pero se rebeló contra él en 2023. Forma parte de la nueva alianza con el TPLF. Los portavoces de Abiy, del Gobierno federal y del TPLF no respondieron de inmediato el miércoles a las solicitudes de comentarios. El Gobierno federal ha acusado al TPLF de violar el Acuerdo de Pretoria y de intentar sembrar el caos. La portavoz de Abiy, Billene Seyoum, declaró el lunes a Reuters que los miembros de la recién anunciada alianza llevaban tiempo colaborando con el respaldo financiero de Eritrea, país vecino y adversario histórico de Etiopía. Eritrea ha negado en repetidas ocasiones las acusaciones de que apoya a grupos armados etíopes. Su ministro de Información se negó a hacer comentarios el miércoles sobre los últimos acontecimientos.

item.title: Un trabajador muere en un accidente en el Coliseo, según el Ministerio de Cultura italiano
item.description: Un trabajador falleció en un accidente ocurrido en el Coliseo de Roma el martes por la noche, informó el Ministerio de Cultura italiano, y parte de la zona permanecía cerrada durante todo el miércoles en señal de respeto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un trabajador falleció en un accidente ocurrido en el Coliseo de Roma el martes por la noche, informó el Ministerio de Cultura italiano, y parte de la zona permanecía cerrada durante todo el miércoles en señal de respeto. El técnico, de 22 años, falleció tras caer unos 10 metros mientras instalaba un nuevo sistema de iluminación en el interior del antiguo anfiteatro romano. "Un suceso trágico que nos ha dejado conmocionados y atónitos", dijo el ministro de Cultura italiano, Alessandro Giuli, en un comunicado. Construido hace 2.000 años, el Coliseo fue el anfiteatro más grande del Imperio romano y se utilizaba para celebrar combates de gladiadores, ejecuciones y cacerías de animales. Sigue siendo una de las principales atracciones turísticas de la ciudad. El Parque Arqueológico del Coliseo anunció que cerraría la sección de la segunda grada, donde se produjo el accidente en señal de luto. El mayor sindicato de Italia, la CGIL, se mostró en desacuerdo con la decisión y afirmó que todo el recinto debería permanecer cerrado durante el día. "Esperamos que el ministro Giuli aclare lo sucedido y ordene el cierre total del Coliseo", dijo Natale di Cola, secretario general de la CGIL en Roma. "La humanidad está por encima de los turistas", añadió.

item.title: LA28 unveils Venice Beach triathlon courses for 2028 Olympics
item.description: Los Angeles 2028 organizers unveiled preliminary triathlon courses for the Olympic and Paralympic Games on Wednesday, setting the events in Venice Beach with a shared finish line overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles 2028 organizers unveiled preliminary triathlon courses for the Olympic and Paralympic Games on Wednesday, setting the events in Venice Beach with a shared finish line overlooking the Pacific Ocean. The routes, which remain subject to operational testing, will use a central transition area near the beach, allowing spectators to watch athletes move between swimming, cycling and running segments. Organizers said the generally flat cycling and running courses were designed to encourage fast racing. The women's individual triathlon at the Games is scheduled for July 15 and will be the first event in which LA28 medals are awarded. The men's individual race will follow the next day with the mixed relay set for July 20. In the individual events, competitors begin with a 1.5 km ocean swim, entering the water directly from the beach rather than from a pontoon. The swim will comprise a 1,000m lap, followed by a brief beach run and a second 500m lap. Athletes will then complete eight 5 km cycling laps, including stretches on the Venice Beach path and city streets, before a four-lap, 10 km run that will cross bridges in the Venice Canals area. The mixed relay will feature teams of four athletes competing in alternating women-men-women-men order. Each athlete will swim 350m, cycle 6.6 km and run 1.6 km before handing off to a teammate. Paralympic individual races, scheduled for August 18-19, 2028, will include a 750 m swim starting from a barge beyond the breakwater, followed by a 20 km bike course and a 5 km run. Events will include athletes across six sport classes. LA28 said the courses will be tested during a World Triathlon T50 Triathlon World Tour event in Venice from July 16-18, 2027.

item.title: McDonald's outlines $8.5 billion plan to support franchisees
item.description: McDonald's on Wednesday outlined about $8.5 billion in franchisee support as part of an expanded growth plan and set targets for margin and market share growth as it looks to revive momentum after several quarters of slower performance.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: McDonald's (MCD.N) on Wednesday outlined about $8.5 billion in franchisee support as part of an expanded growth plan and set targets for margin and market share growth as it looks to revive momentum after several quarters of slower performance. Launched in June, McDonald's "NEXT" strategy focuses on improving food quality, hospitality, value and innovation to boost growth. Persistent inflation and fierce competition over value offerings have pressured McDonald's and other fast-food chains, contributing to slower sales growth in the U.S. and international markets. Last month, McDonald's [USN:L6N44017R TEXT:"missed "]estimates for second-quarter U.S. sales growth, citing execution missteps that hindered efforts to win back lower-income consumers who had cut back on dining out. McDonald's also named industry veteran and company insider [USN:L6N441161 TEXT:"Skye Anderson"] as president of its U.S. business to help drive its turnaround strategy. Ahead of its investor day, McDonald's said it would invest about $8.5 billion in its NEXT strategy through 2036, including roughly $5 billion by 2030, through rent relief and capital support for franchisees. McDonald's said its estimated 250-basis-point efficiency gain would add about $100,000 in annual cash flow for the average U.S. restaurant, with franchisees expected to recoup the investment in about four years. The burger chain targets unit expansion to contribute nearly 2.5% to systemwide sales growth in 2027 and about 2% by 2030, with operating margins expected in the low- to mid-50% range by 2030. The company's total adjusted operating margin for fiscal 2025 was 46.9%.

item.title: EU could recoup third of US economic lead with bigger firms, ECB says
item.description: The European Union could close a third of its productivity gap with the United States if it had as many large companies, the European Central Bank said on Wednesday, adding its voice to calls for reforms that make it easier for businesses to scale up.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Union could close a third of its productivity gap with the United States if it had as many large companies, the European Central Bank said on Wednesday, adding its voice to calls for reforms that make it easier for businesses to scale up. [USN:L6N45A0VH TEXT:"European policymakers"] are [USN:L6N40412Z TEXT:"trying to tackle"] the EU's economic underperformance relative to the United States, which is home to many of the world's largest companies and is leading the race to develop artificial intelligence. EU workers produce 20% less output per hour than their US counterparts, according to academic studies . They were almost on an even keel in 1995. ECB staff found that if Europe had the same distribution of large and small firms as the United States – without changing how productive each type of company is – the productivity gap would shrink by roughly one-third. Large firms are significantly more productive than smaller ones. Companies with at least 250 employees generate an average of €86,800 in value added per worker annually, while firms with fewer than 10 employees produce less than half that amount. The ECB said Europe's weaker productivity performance also reflects lower innovation, fragmented regulation and less developed capital markets, all of which make it harder for companies to grow and compete internationally. The central bank backed the [USN:L8N4072DT TEXT:"proposed "EU Inc" framework"], an EU-wide corporate law regime aimed at reducing barriers to cross-border business activity. Modelled loosely on Delaware's corporate framework in the United States, EU Inc would create a single legal structure operating across the bloc, bypassing a patchwork of 27 national company law systems and dozens of corporate forms. "EU Inc. has the potential to support the Single Market, by strengthening competition, innovation and productivity growth," the ECB said.

item.title: Verizon to invest $70 million in AI training effort
item.description: Verizon is investing $70 million in a nationwide effort to provide AI training to job seekers, small business and educators as the U.S. economy undergoes a dramatic transformation, it said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Verizon (VZ.N) is investing $70 million in a nationwide effort to provide AI training to job seekers, small business and educators as the U.S. economy undergoes a dramatic transformation, it said on Wednesday. The U.S. telecom company is partnering major non-profit programs such as Goodwill Industries and aims to offer AI training to hundreds of thousands of people using training resources from companies including IBM (IBM.N) , Google (GOOGL.O) , Anthropic, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and OpenAI. "AI will change the face of the workforce," Verizon CEO Dan Schulman said in an interview. "You have to do this in order to protect the democracy." Schulman wants large companies to join the effort to boost funding to help workers acquire skills for specific AI-related jobs. "It's in the self-interest of all business leaders to step up," Schulman said. "If every Fortune 100 (company) put $50 million or $70 million into this, we have a multibillion-dollar fund." Verizon announced last year that it was investing $20 million to help departing employees gain AI skills after it announced it was cutting 13,000 jobs. The new effort adds $50 million.

item.title: Columbus Crew despide a técnico Federico Higuaín tras ser acusado de sexismo hacia una árbitra
item.description: El Columbus Crew, club de la Major League Soccer (MLS), destituyó el martes al entrenador del equipo filial, Federico Higuaín, tras una acusación de sexismo hacia una árbitra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Columbus Crew, club de la Major League Soccer (MLS), destituyó el martes al entrenador del equipo filial, Federico Higuaín, tras una acusación de sexismo hacia una árbitra. "No te olvides de que esto es un deporte de hombres", fue el comentario ofensivo que pronunció, según la Asociación Profesional de Árbitros de Fútbol (PSRA). Federico, hermano del exinternacional argentino Gonzalo Higuaín, fue expulsado y sancionado con dos partidos de suspensión tras el altercado ocurrido en un partido el 23 de agosto. "Hemos determinado que lo mejor para nuestro club, los jugadores y el cuerpo técnico es destituir a Federico Higuaín de sus funciones", declaró Issa Tall, director general del Columbus Crew, en un comunicado. "Tras las conversaciones mantenidas esta semana y después de evaluar más a fondo lo ocurrido durante el último mes, se ha constatado que no se han cumplido los estándares de nuestro club en cuanto a lo que se espera de un líder de uno de nuestros equipos", agregó. El incidente tuvo lugar durante un partido de la MLS NEXT Pro, la liga de formación afiliada a la MLS. Sin nombrarlo, la asociación de árbitros afirmó que un entrenador apretó la mano de una árbitra y se negó a soltarla después de que ella le pidiera que parara, antes de proferir el comentario sexista. El Columbus Crew no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre Higuaín. El exdelantero, de 41 años, jugó en Argentina, Turquía y México antes de fichar por el Columbus Crew, donde disputó más de 200 partidos. El sindicato de árbitros criticó la suspensión inicial de dos partidos por considerarla insuficiente y pidió una sanción más severa, alegando que las árbitras no deberían tener que soportar intimidaciones ni comentarios discriminatorios en su lugar de trabajo.

item.title: General Mills dépasse les prévisions de chiffre d'affaires pour le T1
item.description: General Mills a dépassé mercredi les prévisions de chiffre d'affaires pour le premier trimestre, citant une demande accrue de produits de base et de céréales pour le petit-déjeuner.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: General Mills (GIS.N) a dépassé mercredi les prévisions de chiffre d'affaires pour le premier trimestre, citant une demande accrue de produits de base et de céréales pour le petit-déjeuner. Confrontés à une inflation élevée, les consommateurs sont nombreux à préférer manger chez eux, ce qui a stimulé les ventes de produits d'épicerie et d'aliments conditionnés. La société a annoncé un chiffre d’affaires trimestriel de 4,39 milliards de dollars (3,85 milliards d'euros), contre une estimation moyenne des analystes de 4,35 milliards de dollars, selon les données compilées par LSEG. Toutefois, la marge brute ajustée du fabricant de la marque Pillsbury a reculé de 90 points de base pour s'établir à 33,3% du chiffre d'affaires net, en raison de la hausse des coûts des intrants. Elle a réalisé un bénéfice ajusté de 75 cents par action pour le trimestre, contre 86 cents par action l'année dernière.

item.description: The world's most-watched financial marker is hitting levels not seen in decades
item.content:encoded:
